description:
Returns all Prime Contracts for the specified Project.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

id.description: Unique integer identifier of the Prime Contract. Use as the {id} path parameter for GET/PATCH/DELETE /rest/v1.0/prime_contract/{id}.

accounting_method.description: Method used to track the schedule of values: 'amount' tracks lump-sum dollar values, 'unit' tracks quantity multiplied by unit cost.

actual_completion_date.description: Date the contracted work was actually completed, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Null if not yet recorded.

approved_change_orders.description: Total dollar amount of approved change orders on this contract, as a decimal string.

contract_date.description: Date the contract was entered into, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

executed.description: True when the contract has been fully executed (signed by all parties).

execution_date.description: Date the contract was executed (signed), in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

grand_total.description: Total of Line items including markup, plus project level (vertical) markup, if any

number.description: User-facing contract number/identifier displayed in the UI. Distinct from the system-assigned id.

private.description: If true, visible to admins only; otherwise visible to those with access to the parent contract.

show_line_items_to_non_admins.description: If true and the contract is private, non admins with access to the contract will be able to view the SOV items

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the Prime Contract.

title.description: Human-readable title of the Prime Contract.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update, in ISO 8601.

original_substantial_completion_date.description: Substantial completion date as originally agreed, before any approved change orders, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

substantial_completion_date.description: Current substantial completion date, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

outstanding_balance.description: Revised contract amount minus total payments, as a decimal string.

revised_contract_amount.description: Grand total plus approved change orders, as a decimal string.

total_payments.description: Sum of all payments received on this contract, as a decimal string.

draft_change_orders_amount.description: Total dollar amount of all draft change orders, as a decimal string.

pending_change_orders_amount.description: Total dollar amount of all pending and revised change orders, as a decimal string.

pending_revised_contract_amount.description: Revised contract amount plus pending and revised change orders, as a decimal string.

percentage_paid.description: Percentage of the revised contract amount that has been paid, as a decimal string.

owner_invoices_amount.description: Total dollar amount of owner invoices, as a decimal string.

has_change_order_packages.description: True when the contract has at least one change order package.

has_potential_change_orders.description: True when the contract has at least one potential change order.
